judgments.reason: The dataset is the NEMAR derivative of bigP3BCI Study Q (DOI 10.13026/0byy-ry86), and the candidate is the PhysioNet bigP3BCI data descriptor by the same authors.
judgments.paper_title: bigP3BCI: An Open, Diverse and Machine Learning Ready P300-based Brain-Computer Interface Dataset

judgments.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing electrophysiology data into BIDS, used for dataset formatting, not a paper describing the bigP3BCI data.
judgments.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
judgments.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software

judgments.reason: EEG-BIDS is a data-organization standard/specification the dataset's BIDS formatting uses, not a paper describing the bigP3BCI Study Q data.
judgments.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
